name: Object - Employee Wrok Detail
query:
SELECT 
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT eam.project SEPARATOR ', ') AS "Projects:Data:200",
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT eam.object SEPARATOR ', ') AS "Object:Link/Objects:150",
    eam.present AS "Status:Data:100",
    eam.employee AS "Per Employee:Link/Employee:150",
    COUNT(DISTINCT eam.date) AS "Total Days:Int:100",
    SUM(eam.duration) AS "Total Hours:Float:100"
FROM 
    `tabEmployee Attendance Master` eam
WHERE 
    eam.date IS NOT NULL
    AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR %(from_date)s = '' OR eam.date >= %(from_date)s)
    AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR %(to_date)s = '' OR eam.date <= %(to_date)s)
GROUP BY 
    eam.employee, eam.present
ORDER BY 
    eam.employee;
